fields.h1: Build an SEO Agency Landing Page That Turns Audits Into Clients
fields.hero_description: Build an SEO agency landing page that takes audit requests, shows your plans, and saves every lead to a database you own.
fields.explore_cta: Build My SEO Agency Landing Page
fields.features_heading: What Happens Between the Search and the Call
fields.features_subheading: The page earns its keep after the visit. Emergent builds each part below from your prompt and changes it on request.
fields.feature_1:
Audit questions asked one screen at a time

The audit request asks one question per screen, so a prospect on a phone answers the site address before seeing the next field. Reorder the questions by writing one more prompt.
fields.feature_2:
Every request kept in a table you own

Each request lands as a row in a database you own, with the budget in its own column. Sort the rows by budget each Monday morning and call the largest accounts first.
fields.feature_3:
A strategist hears about large budgets first

Set a budget line in plain words and the app emails the strategist on every request above it. Slack and in-app alerts work the same way, with a reminder if nobody replies.
fields.feature_4:
Leads sent to the CRM your sales team uses

The app connects to any tool with an API. HubSpot is one example: each new lead is created there as a contact, so the sales team keeps working from the pipeline it knows.
fields.feature_5:
A new city or service added by message

Ask for a page for Tulsa or a link building offer, and Emergent adds the page with its own form, matching the rest of the site. Leads from the new page join the same table.
fields.feature_6:
Your own domain and code to keep

Custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and hand it to a developer when the agency needs more.

fields.usecase_heading: SEO Agency Landing Page Examples by Offer
fields.tab_content_1:
A $2,500 monthly budget alerts the strategist

Ridgeloft Search offers local businesses a free audit. The form asks for the site address and the 3 keywords the owner wants to rank for, then the monthly budget. Odell Prask of Garrowby Plumbing entered $2,500, above the agency's $2,000 line. The app emailed strategist Juno Ferrante and saved his request as a row.
fields.tab_content_2:
One page for each of 12 service cities

Briarcombe Local wins clients city by city, with a page for each of the 12 cities it serves. Every page carries the same short form and tags each lead with its city. Tamsin Rook of Rook Family Dental wrote in from the Norman page, and her lead saved with the Norman tag.
fields.tab_content_3:
In October, 11 of 18 leads chose Growth at $2,400

Lantern Ridge SEO prints its prices: Growth at $2,400 a month and Scale at $4,800. Each Choose button opens a short form that saves the plan with the lead. In October, 11 of the 18 leads picked Growth, the latest being Lisette Varga, who runs a bakery chain.
fields.tab_content_4:
Any store with over 5,000 products gets a technical audit call

Thistlecrest Growth only works with online stores, and its page asks each one for its product count. Galloway Trail Supply listed 8,200 products, past the 5,000 line. Rhea Okonkwo was offered a technical audit call, and the app created her lead as a contact in HubSpot through its API.

faq_plan.q: What is an SEO agency landing page?
How do I create an SEO agency landing page?

plan.angle: Someone searching for an SEO agency landing page runs or is starting an SEO agency and wants a page that turns search visitors into qualified audit requests. Template galleries stop at a hero and a contact form. This page shows four SEO agency pages built from a prompt and follows each lead to where it lands: a free audit request that captures the site and three target keywords and alerts the strategist when the monthly budget clears $2,000, a local SEO agency with one page per service city that tags each lead with its city, a retainer pricing page that saves the plan each lead picked, and an ecommerce SEO page that offers large stores a technical audit call and sends the lead to the agency's CRM. The FAQ covers the definition, what to put on the page, proof of results, ranking promises, pricing, the audit offer, the form questions, city pages and service pages. Design agency, coaching and consulting pages are siblings and stay out of the headings.
tab_stories: Ridgeloft Search's free audit page asks for the site address, three target keywords and the monthly budget, and because Odell Prask of Garrowby Plumbing enters a $2,500 budget, above the $2,000 line, strategist Juno Ferrante gets an email with his request.
Briarcombe Local publishes one page for each of its 12 service cities, and when Tamsin Rook of Rook Family Dental sends a request from the Norman page, her lead is saved tagged with Norman.

Lantern Ridge SEO lists three monthly retainers, Starter at $1,200, Growth at $2,400 and Scale at $4,800, and saves the plan each lead picks, so the table shows 11 of this month's 18 leads chose Growth.

Thistlecrest Growth's ecommerce SEO page asks each store for its product count, and because Galloway Trail Supply lists 8,200 products, over the 5,000 line, Rhea Okonkwo is offered a technical audit call and her lead is sent to HubSpot.
